# Lab 6.20: Keyless Auth from GitHub Actions with WIF

## What We Are Going to Do
Let a GitHub Actions workflow access Google Cloud with Workload Identity Federation, so no service account key is stored in GitHub.

## Steps

1. **Create the pool and the GitHub provider.** Replace `GITHUB_USER/REPO` with your repository.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam workload-identity-pools create github-pool \
  --location=global --display-name="GitHub pool"

gcloud iam workload-identity-pools providers create-oidc github-provider \
  --location=global \
  --workload-identity-pool=github-pool \
  --issuer-uri="https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com" \
  --attribute-mapping="google.subject=assertion.sub,attribute.repository=assertion.repository" \
  --attribute-condition="assertion.repository=='GITHUB_USER/REPO'"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The attribute condition makes sure only your repository can use this provider.

2. **Create a service account and let the repo use it.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts create gh-deployer
export PROJECT_NUMBER=$(gcloud projects describe $PROJECT_ID --format="value(projectNumber)")

gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding \
  gh-deployer@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser \
  --member="principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/$PROJECT_NUMBER/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github-pool/attribute.repository/GITHUB_USER/REPO"

gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=serviceAccount:gh-deployer@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/storage.objectViewer</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Add the workflow.** In your repo, create `.github/workflows/gcp.yml`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">name: gcp-auth
on: workflow_dispatch
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: projects/PROJECT_NUMBER/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github-pool/providers/github-provider
          service_account: gh-deployer@PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com
      - uses: google-github-actions/setup-gcloud@v2
      - run: gcloud storage buckets list</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Run it.** In GitHub open **Actions → gcp-auth → Run workflow**. The bucket list prints without any secret stored in GitHub.

5. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam workload-identity-pools delete github-pool --location=global --quiet
gcloud iam service-accounts delete gh-deployer@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Secrets in GitHub | None |
| Credentials | Short-lived tokens per run |
| Attribute condition | Only your repository is trusted |
| `id-token: write` | Required for GitHub to issue the OIDC token |
